column1: # Read-through grading of results/ref7b_plain.json (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M, plain structured description, 60 slice questions) against the independent annotation and the gold description. Graded by reading the five lines of each output; strictness: the CALCULATION must be the requested kind of result (count / list / existence / share of time are NOT interchangeable), the period must be stated iff the person stated it (a relative period resolved to the right dates is fine), restrictions/scope must match. G = right; C = wrong calculation; P = period invented or missed; M = wrong measure; A = the question/annotation/gold itself is ambiguous (not counted for or against). Written once, not revised after seeing totals.

d005 C,P why -> "current value"; "last month" missed
